0022600008.text: Boston, 0-1 and fifth in the Atlantic, one game back, hosts the 0-1 New York Knicks, who sit fourth in the Atlantic, in the Celtics' second game of the season. Devin Carter is out with an illness, and last season he averaged 8.9 points and 18.4 minutes per game. The Celtics lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, including a 112-106 loss in New York on April 9, 2026, and the teams have not played each other yet this season.
